Let $u=(u_0,\dots,u_{m-1})$ and $v=(v_0,\dots,v_{m-1})$ be two input sequences of length $m$.
Let $j$ be an index with $0 \le j < m$, naming one position in each sequence.
The pointwise product of $u$ and $v$ is the sequence $w=(w_0,\dots,w_{m-1})$ with $w_j = u_j v_j$ for every such $j$.
Here $r$ is a power of two, and each entry is a polynomial of degree less than $r$, so $r$ is the number of complex coefficients in an entry.
Here $y$ is the indeterminate of the quotient ring $\mathbb{C}[y]/(y^r+1)$ in which the entries lie.
Write $P(u_j,v_j)=u_j v_j/r$ for the normalized pointwise product of two entries, the product in the ring divided by $r$.
